mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_feed ( title, slug, representative_image_url, body, summary, keywords, created_at ) VALUES ( #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{slug,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{representativeImageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{body,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{summary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{keywords,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT news_feed_id AS newsFeedId, title, slug, representative_image_url AS representativeImageUrl, body, summary, keywords, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_feed WHERE news_feed_id = #{newsFeedId}
SELECT news_feed_id AS newsFeedId, title, slug, representative_image_url AS representativeImageUrl, body, summary, keywords, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_feed WHERE slug = #{slug}

SELECT news_feed_id AS newsFeedId, title, slug, representative_image_url AS representativeImageUrl, body, summary, keywords, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_feed ORDER BY created_at DESC, news_feed_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE news_feed SET title = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, body = #{body,jdbcType=CLOB}, representative_image_url = #{representativeImageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, summary = #{summary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, keywords = #{keywords,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE news_feed_id = #{newsFeedId}
